kustomer_customer_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a customer's details change in Kustomer.

output.company_id: The id of the company they belong to, if any
output.custom: Custom attributes by their Kustomer names
output.display_name: The name Kustomer shows for them
output.emails: Every email address on the customer
output.external_id: Your own id for them, if set
output.name: Their full name
output.phones: Every phone number on the customer
output.tags: The ids of the customer's tags
output.time_zone: Their time zone, such as America/New_York

kustomer_new_conversation_trigger.description: Runs when a conversation is started in Kustomer, by a customer or your team.

output.assigned_teams: The ids of the teams it is assigned to
output.assigned_users: The ids of the users it is assigned to
output.channels: The channels used in it, such as email or chat
output.custom: Custom attributes by their Kustomer names
output.customer_id: The id of the customer it is with
output.direction: in when the customer started it, out when your team did
output.external_id: Your own id for it, if set
output.last_activity_at: When anything last happened in it (ISO 8601)
output.name: Its name (subject)
output.snoozed_until: When a snoozed conversation reopens (ISO 8601), if set

kustomer_new_custom_object_trigger.description: Runs when a custom object of the type you choose, such as an order, is added to Kustomer.

output.company_id: The id of the company it belongs to, if any
output.custom: Custom attributes by their Kustomer names
output.customer_id: The id of the customer it belongs to, if any
output.external_id: Your own id for it, if set
output.object_type: The name of its custom object type, such as order
output.title: Its title

parameters.description: The kind of custom object to watch, such as Order.
parameters.name: object_type

kustomer_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is added to Kustomer.

output.company_id: The id of the company they belong to, if any
output.custom: Custom attributes by their Kustomer names
output.display_name: The name Kustomer shows for them
output.emails: Every email address on the customer
output.external_id: Your own id for them, if set
output.name: Their full name
output.phones: Every phone number on the customer
output.tags: The ids of the customer's tags
output.time_zone: Their time zone, such as America/New_York

kustomer_new_message_trigger.description: Runs when a message arrives from a customer in Kustomer, or, if you choose, when your team sends one.

output.app: What it came through, such as postmark or twilio
output.channel: Its channel, such as email, sms or chat
output.created_at: When it was added to Kustomer (ISO 8601)
output.direction: in when the customer sent it, out when your team did
output.external_id: The id it has outside Kustomer, if any
output.preview: Its text, as Kustomer shows it
output.subject: Its subject, for an email

parameters.description: in: messages from customers; out: messages your team sends; any: both. Leave blank for messages from customers.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Only messages on this channel: email, sms, chat, voice, whatsapp, facebook, instagram, twitter-dm or twitter-tweet. Leave blank for every channel.
parameters.name: channel

kustomer_new_note_trigger.description: Runs when someone adds an internal note to a conversation in Kustomer.

output.created_by: The id of the user who wrote it
